The Planner hallucinated or misread this as "Lexington County," leading to an incorrect conclusion about the county. This error was then propagated in subsequent steps, causing the Planner to unnecessarily search for and confirm "Lexington County" before eventually correcting itself to "Richland County" in later steps. This is a classic case of misinterpreting retrieved data, similar to the error patterns seen in Example 5 where the Planner misidentified a county seat based on a misreading of the source text.
